question: Do index-side generated questions (HyPE) find requirements that meaning-queries currently miss?
metric_miss_set: mean recall@5 over the queries in miss_queries.jsonl
metric_gold_set: mean precision@5 over the live-labelled queries of eval/gold_retrieval_queries.jsonl (labels restricted to requirement ids that exist in the live collection; queries with none left, and zero-truth queries, are not scored)
otherwise: record the numbers and stop; do not build
points_are: percentage points (mean metric x 100), arm B minus arm A, same queries, same cached query rewrite and HyDE text in both arms
